subject: Overdue invoice and EU entity remittance - Helio Labs (INV-2026-089)
messages:
From: priyom_das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophia Martinez <sophia.martinez@heliolabs.co.uk>
Cc: Helio Labs AR <ar@heliolabs.co.uk>
Date: 2026-08-15T10:12:00Z
Subject: Reminder: INV-2026-089 overdue (EU entity remittance)

Hi Sophia,

Hope you’re well. I wanted to follow up on invoice INV-2026-089 (due 2026-07-30) for the Redwood platform services. Our records show it’s still outstanding. The payment appears to be in process for a US entity — can you confirm whether Helio Labs GmbH will be remitting?

We noticed two items that are blocking AP from releasing funds:
- The invoice header needs to reflect the EU entity (Helio Labs GmbH) for VAT reconciliation.
- AP requests a copy of your EU VAT registration/certificate (we have attached the current draft and our original invoice).

If you can confirm the entity and share the VAT cert, we can reissue the invoice today and mark it for expedited processing. If reissuance is required, please confirm the billing address and VAT ID to use.

Given the aging balance, our standard collections steps will escalate to a credit hold in two weeks if we don’t have confirmed remit details. We’d prefer to avoid service interruption — happy to set a short payment plan if that helps.

Appreciate a quick confirmation.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: INV-2026-089-original.pdf, helio-eu-vat-cert-request.txt
From: Sophia Martinez <sophia.martinez@heliolabs.co.uk>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Reminder: INV-2026-089 overdue (EU entity remittance)

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the nudge — sorry for the delay. AP is holding payment until we receive an invoice billed to our German entity (Helio Labs GmbH). We also need your confirmation of the VAT reverse-charge treatment on the reissued invoice.

I’ve looped in our AR mailbox (ar@heliolabs.co.uk) — they confirmed they will release payment within 14 days of receiving the corrected invoice and our VAT cert has been attached to this reply for your records.

Can you reissue to:
Helio Labs GmbH
Steinstrasse 9
Berlin, 10115
VAT: DE123456789

Once you send the reissued invoice, I’ll escalate internally to get this scheduled.

Best,
Sophia Martinez
Head of Finance Operations
Helio Labs
Attachments: helio-eu-vat-cert.pdf
From: priyom_das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T09:22:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Reminder: INV-2026-089 overdue (need leadership assist)

Team — quick escalation. Helio confirmed they will only pay once we reissue to Helio Labs GmbH and confirm reverse-charge. They claim payment within 14 days of reissue, but given prior delays I recommend we: 

1) Reissue invoice today to the German entity (I’ve prepared a draft).
2) Send an executive escalation note (senior finance touch) to confirm remit date and reference.
3) If we don’t have funds by 2026-09-06, apply the contracted credit hold and notify product to pause data exports (per SLA).

I’m attaching: reissue draft (INV-2026-089-reissue-draft.pdf) and a suggested executive note. Can Kim or Marissa OK the exec note and send by EOD? If leadership can sign off, I’ll copy legal on the timeline for suspension.

Context: this is a multi-entity bookkeeping issue — the payment has been promised but repeatedly delayed. We should try to preserve the relationship but be clear on consequences.

Thanks,
Priyom
Attachments: INV-2026-089-reissue-draft.pdf, exec-escalation-draft.txt
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophia Martinez <sophia.martinez@heliolabs.co.uk>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T16:40:00Z
Subject: Executive follow-up: INV-2026-089 — confirmation of remit and VAT docs requested

Hi Sophia,

I’m Kim Park, Head of Revenue at Redwood. Priyom asked me to reach out directly to ensure we can close out this invoice without disrupting Helio’s usage.

Thank you for sharing the VAT certificate. To move this forward we need two things confirmed by 2026-09-03:
- Confirmation that Helio Labs GmbH will remit for INV-2026-089 and the payment reference to use.
- A copy of the remittance confirmation once payment is sent.

If we don’t have a confirmed remit date by 2026-09-03 we will place the account on a temporary credit hold per section 5.2 of our agreement; services could be restricted until the balance is resolved. We want to avoid that outcome and are open to a one-off short-term payment plan if that keeps things moving.

I’ll wait for your confirmation and will be available this week if you want to hop on a quick call to unblock AP.

Best regards,
Kim Park
Head of Revenue
Redwood Inference
From: Sophia Martinez <sophia.martinez@heliolabs.co.uk>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>

Hi Kim,

Thanks for the note and for the patience. I’ve confirmed with AP that payment will be executed tomorrow, 2026-09-02, from Helio Labs GmbH. The payment reference will be HL-INV-089-RM and AP asked us to confirm the reissued invoice number matches the one you sent (INV-2026-089).

I’ve attached a remittance stub for your reconciliation. Please confirm once you see the funds and we’ll close the ticket on our side.

Appreciate the fast turnaround on the reissue — it made the process much easier.

Best,
Sophia Martinez
Head of Finance Operations
Helio Labs
